questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence: “Each of the sensors ___ calibrated before use.”
questions.explanation: “Each” takes a singular verb in this construction: “Each of the sensors is calibrated before use.”

provenance.note: Written for this practice bank; not represented as an official or recalled RIL examination question.

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct sentence among the given options:

options.text: Neither the plant operator nor the field technicians was present during calibration.
Neither the plant operator nor the field technicians were present during calibration.
Neither the plant operator nor the field technicians are present yesterday.
Neither the plant operator or the field technicians were present during calibration.

questions.correct_answer: Neither the plant operator nor the field technicians were present during calibration.
questions.explanation: Rule of Proximity for correlative conjunctions 'neither... nor': When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb must agree in number with the closer subject. 'Technicians' is plural, requiring the plural past-tense verb 'were'.

questions.question: Select the pair that best expresses a relationship similar to that expressed in the pair: TRANSIENT : PERMANENCE
questions.explanation: 'Transient' describes something lacking 'permanence' (antonymic quality). Similarly, 'ephemeral' (short-lived) inherently lacks 'longevity' (long life). Both pairs demonstrate an adjective defining the absence of the corresponding noun quality.

questions.question: Read the premise: 'Closed-loop feedback systems dynamically adjust actuator outputs based on measured process deviation from setpoint. While they attenuate external disturbances, improper gain scheduling can induce self-sustaining oscillations.' What is the primary operational risk identified?

options.text: Instability through self-sustaining oscillations caused by poorly tuned controller gain
Inability to respond to process setpoint modifications

questions.correct_answer: Instability through self-sustaining oscillations caused by poorly tuned controller gain
questions.explanation: The passage directly links the risk to 'improper gain scheduling' which 'can induce self-sustaining oscillations', representing closed-loop instability.
